seed_policy: all 5*execs timed trial IDs used exactly once; each exec gets one ID from each fifth of domain; position/stratum rotates; fixed affine permutation
process_trajectory: five distinct preconstructed inputs A,B,C,D,E; A is fresh; B is transitional after one prior sort; C-E are canonical history-conditioned after at least two prior sorts
pairing: each JesseSort variant gets its own immediately adjacent std::sort process using identical five seed IDs/order; AB/BA balanced by exec
scheduling: exec round outer; input/size blocks and variant-pair order deterministically SHA256 shuffled each round
primary_cell_statistics: median runtime; Fresh=A, Transition=B, canonical History=C-E; speedup is ratio of channel medians
secondary_statistics: A-E position medians, p10/p25/p75/p90, SD, paired geometric-mean ratios, win rate
